svg.title: Data storage: a logical table and its physical Parquet layout
svg.desc: Logically, the data is one huge table keyed by image: the caption is the core sidecar, and layout, tags, source, aesthetic score and category are other sidecars. Physically, a dataset revision is a set of Parquet shards; each main shard stores image bytes or an S3 path, and sidecar Parquet files are row-aligned with it. A sample is located by (dataset_revision_id, source_file_id, source_row). Sample values are illustrative.
